W24

Student course grades

/courses/:courseId/grades
Roles: student, instructorScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S09, S19

Provide the missing full learner course-grade view: every visible assessment, released results and an inspectable calculation using published policy. Never substitute staff totals for learner-visible values.

Close detailsClose details
Permissions
  • Student sees own results only; staff preview uses an explicit sample identity.
  • All learner arithmetic uses released snapshots, including released missing/excused status.
  • No TA policy edit/release actions; SIS remains authoritative for official final grades.
  • Instructor entry is an explicitly labeled, read-only learner preview for an authorized selected course member. It does not impersonate the learner or permit review requests, replies, read-state changes or other learner actions.
Responsive
  • Table becomes labelled rows; category method and result status remain visible.
  • Calculation detail uses vertical arithmetic at narrow widths.
Accessibility
  • Table headers identify earned/possible points and release status.
  • Arithmetic has readable textual equations, not an image-only explanation.
Data
  • Published policy and assessment-category mapping; immutable released result set.
  • Release-only included/excluded items, category methods, exact calculation and rounded display.
  • Use data/fixtures.json primary course policy and independent method-test scenario; calculations specified in spec/04_WORKFLOWS_AND_RECORDS.md.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Canonical method test: released 10/10 plus 50/100 yields equal 75% and proportional 60/110 = 54.54545...% before final display rounding.
  • Primary PHYS 110 fixture shows learner 84.50%; held PS4 27/30 changes staff to 85.17% while learner remains 84.50%.
  • Missing and excused affect learner totals only after release; an empty category never creates NaN/Infinity.
  • The separate proposed 10/25/25/40 policy-editor scenario reconciles with its own mapped assessments.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
  • New complete learner view; legacy S09/S19 are lineage rather than an assertion that the accepted baseline already contained it.
